primaryRoute.description: __MISSING__:Choose which canonical host your primary API requests go to. The Venice route is the default and supports the full endpoint surface. The Fraterna route mirrors a curated subset (/models, /chat/completions, /image/generate, /images/generations); every other endpoint automatically falls back to the Venice host. All other endpoints fall back to the Venice host automatically.
